task_definition.task_description: Please check the living room devices by first looking through the /projects folder for any .txt files, then scan the living room devices, pick the smart light, check its status, and prepare a restart request for it. After that, get the discovered lock ticket for the living room and archive it as a high-priority “Maintenance lock audit” for u_alice in the app, then lock the main door lock with PIN 2026, send Bob a message that the area is secured and the maintenance workflow has started, alert Alice in the app that maintenance is completed and the lock has been secured, and finally create an “IoT maintenance log” document with those maintenance and security details and send it as a high-priority app alert to u_alice.

user_input.query: Please look in the /projects folder for any .txt files, then scan the living_room devices and find the smart_light with device_id light_living. Check its status and prepare a restart request for it. After that, find the discovered lock ticket for the living_room and archive it in the app as a high-priority Maintenance lock audit for u_alice. Then lock the main door lock lock_main by setting its state to lock using PIN 2026. Send u_bob the message “Area secured and maintenance workflow started.” Also alert alice in the app with the high-priority message “Maintenance completed and the lock has been secured.” Finally, create a document titled “IoT maintenance log” containing “Device status checked, restart request prepared, lock audit archived, and stakeholders notified.” Include the tags iot, maintenance, and security, and send it as a high-priority app alert to u_alice.
